report.explanation: All checkout observations returned 200 with durations 62-344ms; traces show every span ok, no errors, no pool saturation (pool size 1, idle 1), no redis timeouts, and memory retention well under limit. No public cause is substantiated by current evidence; the single 344ms sample is not enough to establish downstream latency. Handing off for operator review.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency distribution for /v1/checkout to judge whether 344ms is anomalous
Per-dependency latency breakdown (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) to localize any slow hop
Error/timeout logs or non-200 status counts during the alert window
Confirmation of whether an SLO/latency threshold was breached and its value
